title: SAP Connect: available now or still planned?
publicationText:
SAP Connect 2026, in under a minute: what is rolling out, what is available, and what remains planned?

An editorial selection, with sources checked October 14, 2026. Availability may depend on your environment.

Official guide: https://www.sap.com/topics/events/connect/innovation-news-guide-2026
Press release: https://news.sap.com/2026/10/sap-connect-sap-puts-autonomous-enterprise-to-work/

Which announcement should we unpack next?

#SAP #SAPConnect #BusinessAI

scenes.narration: Three SAP Connect announcements, checked October fourteenth. Here is what is rolling out, available now, or still planned.
First, SAP says Joule Work is starting its customer rollout, bringing natural language interaction to work across SAP and third party data.
Second, SAP Reltio is generally available. It reconciles fragmented business records across applications to give AI more consistent context.
Third, SAP Signavio plans deeper analysis of multiagent workflows and AI support for process consulting. General availability is planned for the first quarter of twenty twenty seven.
My takeaway: check the use case, data foundation, and availability together.
